raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Senior Business Analyst with ~8 years of Experience in Business Analysis and over 12 Years of overall Experience in Financial Services at BNY Mellon. Expertise in Requirements Gathering (BRD, FRD), Stakeholder Management, Process re-engineering, and end-to-end delivery across corporate actions, reconciliation, and client servicing domains. Strong experience in Agile/Scrum, UAT coordination, API integration, data analysis (SQL), and building scalable, automation-driven solutions. Proven track record of improving operational efficiency, reducing manual effort, and strengthening risk and control frameworks through strategic business analysis.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies
Business Requirements Gathering (BRD, FRD, FSD), User Stories, Use Cases & Acceptance Criteria • Gap Analysis & Impact Analysis • Business Process Modeling (BPMN) & Process Re-engineering • Stakeholder Management & Requirement Traceability (RTM) • Agile / Scrum Methodology • Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming & Retrospectives • Product Lifecycle Support • User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Coordination, Change & Release Management
Jira, API integration, REST, SOAP, • Confluence, AI • Microsoft SQL Server, AWS • Microsoft Excel, Power Bi • Wireframing & Process Mapping Tools • SQL Querying & Data Analysis • API Integration & API Documentation • Data Validation & Reporting (Excel / SQL) • System Integration & Functional Testing
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
BNY MELLON Senior Business Analyst | Apr 2018 – Present
Associate – Operation and Business Analysis | Sep 2012 – Mar 2018
Project: Global Corporate Actions Processing Platform (GCAPP) • Led end-to-end business analysis for the Portfolio Service System (PSS), supporting global corporate actions processing across multiple markets and asset classes • Collaborate with operations, product owners, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) • Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities • Facilitate stakeholder workshops to define requirements for mandatory and voluntary corporate actions, including client election workflows • Translate complex business needs into functional specifications aligned with mainframe system capabilities • Perform data mapping and reconciliation analysis for entitlements, payments, and exception handling • Define test strategies, test cases, and UAT scenarios in collaboration with QA teams • Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect triage, tracking, and business sign-off • Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely and accurate solution delivery • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and recommended system/process improvements • Support change management, impact analysis, and release coordination activities
Project: Enterprise Reconciliation & Transaction Lifecycle Platform (ERTLP) • Lead end-to-end business analysis for the TLM platform, supporting reconciliation of cash and securities across internal systems and external counterparties. Collaborate with operations, custody, and technology stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) • Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify inefficiencies and define optimized reconciliation workflows • Define and document matching rules, break categories, and exception handling workflows for reconciliation processes • Facilitate stakeholder workshops to align on requirements for internal and external reconciliation, including custodians and brokers
Perform data mapping and data normalization analysis across trade, cash, and position data from multiple source systems • Work closely with development teams to define API specifications for data ingestion, matching engine execution, and reporting services • Support design and implementation of real-time and batch reconciliation processes & Develop functional specifications, data dictionaries, and process flow diagrams (UML, workflow diagrams) • Partner with QA teams to define test strategies, test cases, and reconciliation validation scenarios • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect management, resolution tracking, and business sign-off • Monitor reconciliation breaks, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and recommend rule tuning and process improvements • Support dashboard and reporting requirements, including KPIs, ageing analysis, match rate, and exception summaries • Ensure adherence to risk and control frameworks, including audit trails, maker-checker controls, and SLA tracking • Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely delivery and alignment with business objectives Project Name: Enterprise Client Service & Case Management Platform (ECSMP) • Lead business analysis to transform email-based client servicing into a centralized, SLA-driven case management system. • Gather and document requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) and define end-to-end case lifecycle workflows including intake, assignment, escalation, and closure • Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to design APIs, data models, dashboards, and reporting for real-time tracking and performance monitoring • Drive UAT, ensure audit compliance, and deliver process improvements to enhance SLA adherence, transparency, and operational efficiency
Project Name: Operational Automation & Controls Platform (Baseline) • Lead business analysis to identify and automate high-risk operational processes, including corporate action payments on loaned securities at BNY Mellon • Gather and document requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) and define workflows for tax withholding, Section 302 processing, and automation use cases • Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to implement automation solutions, reducing manual effort, improving processing efficiency, and strengthening operational controls
Business Analyst Eclerx Services Limited | Nov 2011 – Aug 2012 Project: Derivatives Documentation & Reconciliation Optimization
Performed detailed validation and reconciliation of derivative documentation by verifying economic parameters and matching system data, ensuring accuracy and timely discrepancy resolution. • Generated and analyzed monthly business reports on valuation statements and query trends, enabling improved tracking, transparency, and decision-making. • Managed high-volume operations with strong SLA adherence, minimizing errors and enhancing overall process efficiency and data quality.
Business Analysis & API Mastery Certification from MAD4API Technologies | Mar 2024

raw_sections.awards:
Key Achievements
Drove automation and process optimization initiatives across corporate actions and reconciliation platforms, reducing manual intervention by ~20% and improving overall operational efficiency • Enhanced reconciliation accuracy and match rates by optimizing matching rules and data mapping in TLM, resulting in ~18% increase in auto-match rates and ~20% reduction in exceptions • Led successful implementation of SLA-driven case management system, improving turnaround time by ~25% and increasing SLA adherence by ~30%, significantly enhancing client servicing and transparency
